subject: Welcome pack credit request — BrightAtlas onboarding
messages:
From: Ari Patel <ari@brightatlas.ai>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: New signup — request for evaluation credits

Hi Soojin —

We just signed up a small team at BrightAtlas (we're building a spatial search prototype) and used the self-serve flow this morning. We're seeing traffic in the sandbox but would love a short evaluation boost to run a larger embedding job (~500k tokens) to validate latency and cost.

Attached the signup payload and a quick screenshot of the intercom chat where we asked for credits. If possible, we'd like a $1,000 credit or an equivalent token bucket for the next two weeks. Happy to share more details on usage patterns — mostly batched embeddings + a few chat endpoints for internal demos.

Thanks —
Ari
CTO, BrightAtlas
ari@brightatlas.ai

Attachments: signup_payload.json (application/json), chat_screenshot.png (image/png)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Patel <ari@brightatlas.ai>
Date: 2027-08-01T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: New signup — request for evaluation credits

Hi Ari —

Thanks for signing up and for the details — welcome! A couple quick clarifying questions so I can triage faster:
- Is BrightAtlas evaluating embeddings at production scale or primarily for a single pilot dataset?
- Do you expect steady daily embedding volume or a one-time large batch?
- Any hard deadline for demos this month?

If you prefer, we can jump on a 15-min call to review the expected token profile; otherwise I can route this for a short trial credit approval once I have the answers.

I'll loop in our growth ops if we decide to proceed.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Growth Ops — Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Quick +1 to approve. BrightAtlas looks like a PLG eval with potential to expand; $1k is within the rapid-approve threshold for new signups.

Operational notes for the issuer: allocate as a time-limited credit (14 days), scope to their account id (once created); include guidance on batching recommendations and an activation link.

Tessa — can you or ops issue the credit and send the activation guide? If you need a custom token bucket instead of dollar credits, 1k USD ~= 1,000,000 embedding-unit credits for the profile they gave (round numbers — ops can calculate exact).

Ben

ben.carter@redwood.ai

Date: 2027-08-02T14:05:00Z
Subject: Credits issued — BrightAtlas evaluation

Hi Ari —

Thanks for the details and patience. We've issued a time-limited evaluation credit to your new BrightAtlas account: $1,000 USD equivalent, valid for 14 days from activation. You should see an "Eval Credits" section in the console once you verify your account.

Next steps and notes:
- Activation: follow the attached activation-guide.pdf (opens with steps to confirm billing and enable token bucket).
- Suggested config: enable batch embeddings at size 256, set concurrency to 4 to balance throughput/latency.
- If you plan a >500k token one-off, consider splitting into 5 smaller batches to avoid transient memory spikes.

If you want, I can schedule a 20-min walkthrough on Thursday to review embedding settings and cost estimates.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Growth Operations — Redwood Inference
attachments: activation-guide.pdf
